description: This Kotlin source file defines composable functions related to scrollbars in Jetpack Compose for different lazy layout states (LazyListState, LazyGridState, LazyStaggeredGridState). It includes functions to create draggable scroll behaviors reacting to thumb position displacements, utilizing remember and LaunchedEffect to synchronize scroll position with thumb dragging.
